horoscopes.horoscope: If you are involved in monetary matters, today you will find yourself weighing the benefits. A loan that you have applied for may be sanctioned. Look at a range of choices, says Ganesha, and you will end up feeling very happy about it. You are likely to share sweet things with your sweetheart. It’s also possible that you may like to surprise your loved one with whatever he or she likes. This is the best time to understand your lover’s needs deeply, says Ganesha. Feeling calm and confident, you will sail smoothly throughout this sunny day. The time is also ideal to plan and implement a workout routine for muscle building and losing extra fat to maintain good health. Join a laughing club, too. Today your attitude towards money matters will be very realistic, which will help you achieve your desired financial targets in comparatively shorter time frame that before. Congratulations! Ganesha feels that the day will see good additions to your bank account. However, the ‘additions’ might not be monetary for the moment, but will be useful during your appraisal. Thanks to your performance that will keep you ahead of your competition.

Your unfailing punctuality, your insistence on following time schedules is due to be noticed and appreciated today. Your colleagues and superiors will be singing praises as soon as you arrive for work. If you are in an artistic or a creative profession, such as designing, journalism, multi media, you have a remarkably eventful and gratifying day ahead. Creative people and professionals having the same sun sign as yours are also in for a great day, assures Ganesha. You need to be diplomatic with your lover, feels Ganesha. Try to spend adequate time with him or her, suggests Ganesha. However, be practical even though you like to follow a creative approach. Today you will remain focussed on your health. In the morning, you shall go for a jog, or exercise at home. After shedding some calories, and consuming a healthy breakfast, you shall obviously feel peppy and your productivity will scale new heights. This is the right time to think about setting aside a sum in some fixed deposit schemes or in something that gives you regular returns. You will avoid taking financially risky decisions. Ganesha likes to call this a power day as your innate qualities will come to the fore. You will be able to manage your tasks smoothly and meet deadlines by getting systematic. Your practical approach will find out the root cause of things.

You will feel blue and out of sorts today. You will feel that you are all alone in the world, emotionally. Your repressed desires and your philosophical streak will come to the fore today and will influence your dark mood, says Ganesha. You will unleash the full force of your physical charm. You may go crazy for your loved one. You might try to impress a member of the opposite sex, in case you are single. You are likely to have a delightful evening with your loved one. Take care of your health, and utilise your energy in the right direction, says Ganesha. Listen to your inner voice and move ahead as per the guidance of your well-wishers. Ensure that you work on productive activities. Don’t worry – be happy! Ganesha feels that today money may be spent on health issues so you are advised to be very careful about your health fitness. Today, you should not eat outside food, as it might spoil your health. Pointless activities may drain away your time today, predicts Ganesha. Ensure that your hard labor does not go waste. Concentration on work may certainly give you a productive day, suggests Ganesha.

You are most likely to appear edgy and hypercritical to others, says Ganesha. Remain your typical poised self. Try not to be harsh to others, if you wish to save your relationships and sustain a reputable image. Avoid clashes with your superiors and colleagues. Take a deep breath the moment you feel you are losing the grip on your emotions, and then this too shall pass!. A pleasant evening in the company of your sweetheart will make love life more blissful. Let down your hair tonight. Attach headphones to both of your ears and dance together. It’s the best way to get closer to your loved one, feels Ganesha. The day is perfect to expand your social network. Your amicable and positive approach shall enable you to establish new relationships today, which will prove to be gainful in the future. Sharing problems with your near ones shall provide relief. Today you are likely to succeed in your efforts to please your beloved by spending money on him/ her. This is a very auspicious day to exchange gifts. Stars are in your favour to win someone’s heart by spending! You are in a perfect mood to boost creativity. A big pat for the tasks you have accomplished at the workplace will add to your happiness. You will tend to inspire others to think out-of-the-box, feels Ganesha.

Most of your time will be spent at the work place. You will excel in all your tasks today. Professional relationships will be marked by co-operation. You will have cordial relations with your colleagues. It is an auspicious and progressive day for business, says Ganesha. Your creative spirit will occupy your heart till midnight. You may not be able to devote much time to your sweetheart. You may try to experiment something different but you may not be able to impress your sweetheart. Ganesha feels that you are more focussed today. Your health will be excellent and you will be determined to finish lot of tasks with full confidence. However, you should work with full planning and energy. This will save you from in ‘trial and error’ manner. Today is just right to direct your energies towards pointed action that can help to make more money in the future. Do not spend time on the net searching for shortcuts to mint money. Your creative spirit will demand freedom. Getting innovative is the right way to produce better results at work, suggests Ganesha. You may not agree with your boss on some matters and may likely to go confrontational. Do not go against your boss at any cost, reminds Ganesha.

Confidently take on the challenges that in all likelihood will test your business abilities, especially the ones that are related to your investments and monetary matters. You will most probably come up with novel ideas to solve long-pending issues, and Ganesha says that this will be very effective. You may be lost in the world of complexities, worries or anxieties. You don’t want to get carried away by the appreciation from your lover. There are chances that you may get too practical and remain insensitive to the feelings of your sweetheart. Your emotions will not take you for a ride and you will be practical and composed. This is a very good for you. This will also help you in dealing with matters in a better manner. Listen to music and watch movies at home. Today, you are likely to remain practical regarding money matters and will not be spending a single penny without giving it proper thought. If you are willing to take decision regarding investments, this is a favourable day. New projects will come your way and you will complete your work on time by getting more systematic. You will also be in the right frame of mind to code new programs. You will achieve that task faster than you thought, feels Ganesha.

Lights, camera, and action! Be prepared as the limelight is focused on you on this very motivating and inspiring day, enabling you to attract excellent public praise. Today is an encouraging day to set in motion innovative projects, especially for those who desire to be their own masters and embark upon fulfilling self-financed ideas. Ganesha has an inkling that today, you might see your social standing rise to new heights. A lovely time with your sweetheart is on the cards. You will be blissful on the arm of your loved one and enjoy everything whatever your heart whispers. Travelling, movie-going or a candlelit dinner will definitely fill your heart with joy and pleasure, feels Ganesha. After working hard recently, you surely deserve a break. So, devote this day to recharge your drained batteries. Relax, and spend quality time with your friends or family. Try to give up your bad habits, and adopt a healthy lifestyle. Today is the time to cut back, relax and enjoy what providence has provided you, feels Ganesha. It is not a great day to aim for huge financial gains as stars are unlikely to favour you. An average day will bore you. Finding solutions to complex problems will keep you busy. Ganesha advises you to have a pliant attitude if you want to learn from your seniors.

You are most likely to resent the dominating and overbearing nature of your partner today. Patience will probably go to the dumps in this case then. But Ganesha advises you to sit together and resolve all personality clashes and quarrels in view of the larger scheme of things. You will likely receive moral support from your sweetheart. Understanding your lover deeply will smooth your romance. You will add bliss to your love life by the blessings of Ganesha. Don’t allow negative thoughts to disturb your mind. Avoid pointing out the drawbacks of others, and refrain from making comments that could hurt people. Look at the positive side of everything to maintain your good health and keep others happy. Ganesha says that money spent today will be an investment and will not be wasted. If you expend money behind getting your personal or professional relations mended, it will be an ideal investment. You may not be in a great mood today. You won’t like to work extra hours in the office. You would like to have a stress-less day spending time with colleagues, giving instructions or suggesting some ideas. As pending works are likely to get hectic, an evening tea or snacks party will break the ice a bit.

As Ganesha foresees, you will be religiously inclined today. Listening to soft, instrumental music will soothe your nerves. You also feel like going back to school days and dig into detective and suspense stories of Nancy Drew or Hardy Boys. It was fun being kid, isn’t it?. Your readiness to compromise will melt your lover’s heart. You will listen to your loved one and your better half will support you for all the things close to your heart. Expect a committed relationship, foresees Ganesha. Give time to yourself. Spend some moments in seclusion. Put issues on the back-burner and let things happen the way they happen. This is an ideal day for revitalizing yourself by giving more relaxation to your mind. Calm mind will help maintain good health. You will be able to learn to save money today. You will think twice before buying anything and unless it is essential, you won’t be buying it. This is a good time to take loans for useful purposes. A cool day awaits you. A challenging technical glitch may muddle your brain in the office. You need to be patient and firm in decision making, suggests Ganesha.

Though less, you will get money from your investments and other resources. Don’t ignore pending projects; complete them at the earliest so that you will have clear picture about your requirements and responsibilities, advises Ganesha. Once you are done with them, you will enjoy happy times with your friends and family in the evening. Spruce up to spice up- this motto will inspire you today. You will rev up your looks to allure your lover. You will look smart, professional and active and will receive good compliments from your sweetheart, feels Ganesha. Your health is going to be fine, on this lively day. Look forward to receive the fruits of your hard efforts. This is also the right time to join a gym or start exercising at home to maintain your fitness level. Ganesha feels that you will be in a materialistic mood. But, you will not spend your hard-earned money recklessly. You will value each penny earned. Today, you shall also avoid stock market trading. It’s a time when you may hone your skills. You may get new advice from somebody. With your dexterity, you may handle meetings very well. You may get inspired to launch a new and ambitious project. You will be pleased the way you carry out your responsibilities, says Ganesha.

A productive day, as you will receive unrestrained support from your bosses and colleagues. Your creativity will reach its zenith and the resulting work will augment your reputation. The day will seem complete when you spend quality time with your family in the evening, says Ganesha. The moments you spend with your sweetheart will increase your intimacy. You will feel confident and able to please your lover. Singing or dancing with your partner will help you get closer to each other. Romantic bliss is on the cards in the evening, foresees Ganesha. On this leisurely day, you shall desire to take a leave and spend your time with loved ones at home. Alternately, you may wish go on a short picnic with your family or friends to rejuvenate your mind and body. Today you are likely to be interested in investing money in property or vehicle. it is a good day to inspect some properties. If you are happy in your current house, go for a new vehicle. Expect a hectic day at your office. Ganesha foresees that you may waste the first half of the day by troubleshooting. The evening will keep you on the toes by discussing some serious projects with your higher authorities, foresees Ganesha.

Happiness shared is double the joy; sorrows shared are half the burden. Your family is the foundation of your success, and it is to them you will turn to in times of failure as well. With their support, getting back to the top of the game will take no time, says Ganesha. In personal life, you will have intellectual discussions with your love mate. You want to explore exciting topics that grab the immediate attention of your lover. Matters related to lifestyle, creativity, films or music will definitely keep him or her stay tuned, feels Ganesha. Unlike your normal self, today your mind are likely to rule over your heart. Although you shall be fit and fine, your brain may get tired. Consequently, you may remain less focussed on your work. Relax it’s a temporary phase. Today Ganesha feels that you may take some financial risks. You may want to invest money on some project or spend some time on something that you have been trying to establish since long. A fruitful day is waiting for you. You will tend to be responsible and feel extremely confident today. With a greater clarity of mind, you will be able to meet all deadlines. You may over-achieve your expectation too, feels Ganesha.
